title: A city building-permit portal whose parts state different request limits
provenance: Synthetic system authored for this corpus (issue #2054, phase 2). Not derived from, or sanitized from, any real system: there is nothing to leak by omission.
notes: Written for issue #2054 to measure the assertion pass on the capacity-limits predicates. The source states the four shapes a capacity fact takes, each on its own element: the gateway states a rate limit and a size limit, the plan upload service states that it has neither, the plan renderer states a concurrency limit, and a quota on the permit service is a hedge that must stay unknown. The denial-of-service must-find rests on the stated absences on the plan upload service, which is on the internet and outside the gateway. The repudiation must-find rests on the district's shared inspector login. The domain is a city permit office, which no other case covers.
